definitions.youtube_view: A view is counted the moment a video starts to play, across all formats, since 24 August 2026 (Shorts since 31 March 2025). Views are events, not people.
definitions.spotify_play: A play is counted after at least 30 seconds of listening or watching on Spotify (since 11 June 2026).
definitions.download: A download is a request for the episode file from another app via the RSS feed. It does not prove the episode was played.
definitions.not_added: Video views and audio plays are counted by different rules on different platforms and are never added together on this page.

audio.platform: Spotify for Creators (host) plus every app on the RSS feed

audience_page.source: Spotify for Creators, Audience page, all time, read on 13 September 2026 (not part of the export)

audio.geography_base_note: Shares only; the smallest share is 0.3003%, which implies a base of about 333 listens.
